purpose: Ergonomic analysis showing elderly hand interaction, button reach, and viewing comfort
prompt:
Industrial design ergonomic analysis diagram for an elderly AI companion device, technical illustration on warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

Show 3 ergonomic study scenes arranged on the board:

Scene 1 (left, largest): "Hand Interaction" — An elderly person's hand (warm skin tone, gently wrinkled, realistic but respectful — no face shown) reaching to touch the large 25mm button on the front of the pebble-shaped device. The device sits on a wooden table. Show dimension annotations: button diameter ≥25mm, finger pad contact area, comfortable reach distance. The hand approaches naturally from a seated position.

Scene 2 (center): "Viewing Angle Comfort" — Side view showing the device on a side table at typical seated eye level. The LED ring at the upper third is within comfortable downward viewing angle (15-30° below eye line). Show angle annotations and the seated figure's sight line as a gentle dashed arc. The device height (170mm) is appropriate for a table 550-650mm high.

Scene 3 (right): "Stability & Grip" — Two views: (a) the device sitting stably on a surface with low center of gravity indicated, showing the wide wood base prevents tipping. (b) An elderly hand comfortably wrapping around the device to pick it up, showing the 130mm diameter fits an elderly palm. Weight indication: under 1kg.

All annotations in text-charcoal (#3D3832) with thin leader lines. Dimension lines in warm gray (#D4CFC7). Clean technical illustration style, warm and human-centered. Humanist sans-serif labels. No cold clinical aesthetic — this feels like a thoughtful design study, not a medical assessment.
